description: This Java class implements email sending functionality using JavaMailSender and FreeMarker templates. It prepares and sends multipart emails with both text and HTML content, supporting configuration overrides, and is part of the package 'com.salesmanager.core.modules.email'.

classes.name: HtmlEmailSenderImpl
classes.description: Implementation of email sending with templated content, supporting both text and HTML parts, using FreeMarker for template processing and JavaMailSender for delivery.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Generates email content from a template and sends an email with both text and HTML parts, supporting configuration overrides.
